text.title: Retro Facilitation Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals from the retro instance (distribution, fatigue, safety check, action items, previous-action status, timebox) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the chosen format fit the team's distribution and fatigue, were previous actions reviewed, and are the new action items 1-3, owned, linked and dated?

conclusion.verdict: skip: write a single retro doc; no versioned instance

branch.when: format not in the 5 supported formats OR distribution == async AND format != anonymous-async OR format == lean-coffee AND distribution == async

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: async teams run anonymous-async; lean-coffee needs everyone on one live board

branch.when: selection_rationale < 20 chars OR rationale does not name distribution, fatigue signal and the last two formats

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: write the team-state rationale with the previous two formats

branch.when: fatigue_signal == fatigued AND format used in either of the last 2 retros OR fatigue_signal == rotating AND format == previous format

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: rotate to a format not used in the last two retros

branch.when: no Prime Directive / safety check recorded OR safety median < 3 without switch to anonymous input OR non-member manager in the discussion

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: run the safety check; switch to anonymous cards below 3; manager leaves for discussion

branch.when: previous instance's action items have no done / not-done / dropped status

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: walk the previous actions first; carry over once, then drop with a reason

branch.when: action_items count == 0 OR > 3 OR any owner not a named person OR missing evidence_link OR due_date after next retro

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: 1-3 items, one named owner each, tracker link created in the retro, due before next retro

branch.when: format == anonymous-async AND collection window shorter than one working day in every timezone OR cards carry author identity

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: extend the window across all timezones; strip identity; cluster before recap

branch.when: no timebox recorded before start OR actual duration > timebox OR lean-coffee topic extended more than twice

conclusion.verdict: REPAIR: publish the timebox; dot-vote and clock each lean-coffee topic; log the overrun into the next fatigue signal
APPROVE: retro instance is canonical; schedule the outcome review for the next retro

text.example: Async team, fatigue rotating, last two formats sailboat and 4ls → anonymous-async with a 2-working-day window across UA/PT/UK; safety median 4; previous 2 actions marked done; 1 new action owned by Carol with GitHub issue #482 due before next retro; 60-minute recap timebox held → APPROVE.
